assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Diagnosis code I34.0 is associated with nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency

Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
